sql:
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) AS TotalOnHand,
    sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity) AS TotalSafetyStock,
    sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) - sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity) AS InventoryGap
FROM retail.FactInventory fi
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON fi.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
ORDER BY InventoryGap DESC
LIMIT 10
